questions.stem: What happens if a mutation occurs in a body cell rather than a gamete?

options.text: It will definitely be passed to offspring
It will not be passed to offspring but may affect that organism
It has no effect at all
It will cause the cell to die immediately

questions.explanation: Mutations in body cells are not passed to offspring because they are not in the reproductive cells. However, they can still affect the organism, for example by causing uncontrolled cell division (cancer).
